guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Shared lifecycle gates must be documented and tested at every consumer boundary.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The design document and gate/Finish/archive/PR/close regression suites cover the shared boundary.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Generated status and Outcome artifacts remain derived; do not hand-edit them as a substitute for the authoritative lifecycle path.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The implementation writes derived artifacts through Finish/archive generators; tests validate the resulting bindings.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep the implementation project-neutral so template adopters inherit the same behavior.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The shared validator is catalog-installed and the distributed AI Cockpit rules plus installer E2E tests cover adopter parity.

risk.detail: Lifecycle terminality and evidence binding are high-consequence boundaries; the shared gate and full quality route are required verification.

observedIssues: The prior implementation could persist or summarize Outcome without a complete direct conversation result, and downstream consumers did not share one green/current binding gate.
Archive path rewriting changed Summary bytes after Outcome creation, leaving summaryDigest stale; archive now refreshes bindings from the final persisted Summary.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed and no residual risk remains.
expectedReviewFocus: Direct conversation Outcome must remain complete and traffic-light marked.
Archive, PR, and close must reject missing, stale, yellow, red, or malformed Outcome evidence.
Installed adopter projects must contain the shared gate and inherited hard boundary.

userCorrectionsCaptured: Outcome must be a complete, independent, explicit conversation-visible result with 🔴/🟡/🟢; folded tool output is not acceptable.
A Work Item cannot end unless Outcome passes; the result is not complete merely because it is stored in files or mixed into status updates.
Fix discovered problems in the current Work Item first; create a successor only for genuinely different scope, authority, or base.
After the existing objectives are complete, publish a new version.
userCorrectionSolidification: ai-finish now emits the complete Outcome directly, and only completed green evidence can cross archive/PR/close terminal boundaries.
The current-Work-Item remediation rule is present in both the repository rules and the distributed adopter template.

checkpointEvidence.reason: The shared Outcome gate imports a new module and the inherited lifecycle rules plus installer parity test were added; scope now records the actual current-WI and adopter-engineering surfaces.
The existing archive transaction fixtures require updated valid green Outcome evidence to reflect the new terminal gate; the touched regression file is now explicitly owned.

The authoritative Capability Truth regeneration exposed its downstream Japanese capability assessment as stale; add both generated assessment projections to the current Work Item so the evidence chain is closed before Finish.

The complete source-bound verification chain also requires the generated pre-release documentation-alignment projections after refreshing the Japanese capability assessment; add them so all downstream bindings are regenerated within this Work Item.

Strict quality found the new design document is governed documentation and must carry front matter plus documentation-context registry membership; add the registry to this current Work Item before repairing the metadata.

Add the adoption lifecycle validation harness because the current green Outcome gate exposed an existing make-variable propagation defect: fixture quality overrides were only ambient environment values and were lost at the Makefile boundary, so every adopter shard could not complete the same terminal Outcome path.

The green-gate regression exposed a second root mismatch in first-adoption evidence: its intentionally out-of-scope project-quality gap was recorded as an unclassified known gap, forcing a yellow Outcome even though the adoption acceptance boundary was complete. Add explicit Contract-bound non-risk evidence so the gate remains strict while scoped adoption can truthfully reach green with the residual risk visible.

overclaimPrevention: Do not report completion for checks or behavior that were not verified.

The current Contract and Summary declare and record the implementation boundary.
Repository and adopter rules plus the authoritative Finish command document the direct Outcome boundary.
Traffic-light markers and the terminal status are language-neutral; no new localized documentation surface was added.
The Contract records scope boundaries and the design records the current-WI versus successor rule.
